title: FHA Home Loans

faqs.a: The minimum down payment is 3.5% of the purchase price.

faqs.q: Are gift funds allowed for FHA loans?
faqs.a: Yes, borrowers can receive all of their down payment, closing costs, and prepaid taxes and insurance from a gift.

faqs.q: What credit score do I need for an FHA loan in Arizona?
faqs.a: Most lenders require a minimum credit score of 620, though some may go as low as 580 in certain cases.

faqs.q: How long do I have to pay mortgage insurance on an FHA loan?
faqs.a: - For loans with less than 10% down, mortgage insurance is required for the entire loan term<!-- [et_pb_line_break_holder] -->- For loans with 10% or more down, mortgage insurance can be removed after 11 years of on-time payments

faqs.q: What are the current FHA loan limits in Arizona?
faqs.a: - As of 2026, the FHA loan limit for a single-family home in most Arizona counties, including Maricopa, is $557,750<!-- [et_pb_line_break_holder] -->- Limits are higher for multi-unit properties and in certain counties like Coconino

faqs.q: Can I use an FHA loan to buy a condo?
faqs.a: Yes, but the condo project must be FHA-approved, which can be challenging in Arizona.

faqs.q: What's the maximum seller contribution on an FHA loan?
faqs.a: Sellers can contribute up to 6% of the sales price towards a buyer’s closing costs and prepaids.
